svg.title: CL-02 concept layout drawing
svg.text: 1. Concept layout for review and alignment. Placeholder geometry: not a design, not for manufacture.
2. Dimensions in millimetres; scale 1:50 on A3. Third-angle projection.
3. Centre of gravity uses placeholder effective densities (cad/params/common.yaml).
4. Static margin: shortest distance from CG to the support-polygon edge; tip angle = atan(margin / CG height).
5. Docked rotor to pilot 630; UAV drawn in blue; 1.75 m person in grey.
⚠ static margin 145 mm is under the 300 mm review flag
⚠ docked rotor 630 mm from the pilot: under the 1000 mm flag
CL-02 · Biped, seated protected cockpit, shoulder-mounted dock
